answer: New identities begin quarantined on a low-value island shard where each agent may only settle micro-transactions, so a Sybil farmer's thousand clones earn pennies while paying full compute and attestation fees per clone. Honest work over many epochs gradually earns migration into the shared lagoon market with larger limits, and every crossing is written to a basalt-hard ledger: one fraud proof burns the whole island's deposits and resets its migration clock. Clones therefore cost more to run than they can ever extract.
